metaDescription: VentureMarket connects buyers and sellers of real, revenue-generating businesses.
title: About VentureMarket
intro: VentureMarket is a marketplace built for people who are serious about buying and selling startups — not a classifieds board. We built the tooling we wished existed when acquiring our own first business: real financial data, verified sellers, and a deal room that carries a transaction from first message to closed transfer.

values.discoveryDescription: Every listing goes through a structured review flow before it's published, so buyers spend time evaluating real opportunities.
values.verificationDescription: Identity, ownership, revenue, and traffic checks are built into the platform, not bolted on after the fact.
values.workspaceTitle: A workspace for the whole deal
values.workspaceDescription: Messaging, offers, due diligence, documents, and the deal room live in one place so nothing falls through email threads.
